instrument_selection: p<5e-8 in exposure; 500kb distance-based pseudo-clumping (no PLINK/LD reference in this env; reported honestly)
harmonisation: effect-allele; exact rsID else nearest-variant within +/-300bp; palindromic SNPs dropped
interpretation: Null: genetically higher plasma HP does NOT alter SAH risk (OR 0.98, 95% CI 0.89-1.07, p=0.62). Consistent with the mechanism in this paper: HP acts in secondary injury after aneurysm rupture, not in preventing rupture itself. No heterogeneity (Q p=NS), no directional pleiotropy (Egger intercept p=0.94), instruments strong (mean F=335, min F=30).
engine: 14_mr.py two-sample MR engine, previously validated on synthetic ground truth (true beta=0.40 recovered as IVW=0.413)
